Classic parabolic trap my journal flags. Hard pass. PENN: here is what BOTH undersold — the candidate table shows 1d +2.3%, 5d +1.3%, 30d +36.3%. On JNJ I fully agree with the bear's 'confirmatory not surprise + thin 6.5% reward' — pass. On MRNA the bear's case is airtight (no product, CDC self-dampened, parabolic) — hard pass.
